Why_Suspicious: ALL ZEROS - if this were populated with post-event fraud counts from device, it would be leakage. Currently uninformative.
Leakage_Risk: Confirmed leakage if nonzero in future; currently Safe (constant)
Recommendation: Remove from training features - zero variance, uninformative

Why_Suspicious: These may incorporate real-time signals. If computed on the same batch including the fraud event, they are leakage.
Recommendation: Use with caution. Ensure these are computed on data BEFORE the current transaction.

Why_Suspicious: If computed post-approval, this aggregates fraud signals. If computed pre-application, safe.
Recommendation: Requires source documentation to determine computation timing.

Why_Suspicious: This is a SYSTEM FLAG that theoretically flags fraud AFTER detection. Using it as a feature would be direct leakage.
Recommendation: Remove completely from feature set. Only use isFraud as target.

Why_Suspicious: Balance AFTER transaction. Computed simultaneously with fraud decision. In real-time, this is not available before fraud scoring.
Recommendation: Remove from feature set for real-time inference. Use oldbalanceOrg only.

Why_Suspicious: Balance of destination AFTER transaction. Same issue as newbalanceOrig.
Recommendation: Remove from feature set for real-time inference.

Why_Suspicious: If this count includes the CURRENT transaction, it leaks information about transaction frequency at fraud time.
Recommendation: Must verify: does count include current transaction? If yes, subtract 1.

Why_Suspicious: Location mismatch requires knowing cardholder location at time of transaction. Verify this is available in real-time.
Recommendation: Safe if computed from device GPS vs. billing address. Verify computation method.
